steps.title: PPE and furnace zone
steps.body: Face shield, heat gloves and apron are mandatory inside the yellow line. Confirm the argon purge valve is open before charging.

steps.title: Mold and furnace setup
steps.body: Fit graphite mold MLD-GB-0.5, preheat to 180 °C. Set melt temperature to 1080 °C.

steps.title: Pre-pour checks
steps.body: Tick every line before the first pour.

steps.title: Pouring
steps.body: Pour in one continuous motion per cavity. Log every shot on the weigh sheet. Reject shots below 0.5 g net before cooling.

steps.title: Reference pour
steps.body: Correct meniscus after the pour.

steps.title: Die change
steps.body: Mount press die DIE-GB-0.5, torque to 45 Nm. Run three blank strokes and check alignment with the gauge.

steps.title: First-piece approval
steps.body: Supervisor signs before series production.

steps.title: Series pressing
steps.body: Feed blanks one at a time; never reach into the die area while the ram is enabled.

steps.title: Compound and cycle
steps.body: Dose polishing compound per BOM and run the 12 minute cycle. Rinse with cleaning solvent and dry with lint-free cloth.

steps.title: Surface check
steps.body: Inspect under the loupe before releasing the batch.
items: No compound residue in the relief

steps.title: Acceptable finish
steps.body: Mirror finish reference sample.

steps.title: XRF procedure
steps.body: Calibrate XA-01 with the Au 99.99 reference standard. Take three readings per sample and record the mean.

steps.title: Sample handling
steps.body: Handle samples with tweezers only.

steps.title: Analyser manual
steps.body: XRF analyser operating procedure.

steps.title: Blister assembly
steps.body: Per piece, in this order.
